# Case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the complete identity
# in each Co-authored-by trailer. Keep patterns specific enough to avoid
# matching ordinary human co-authors. Add exact names or email domains when a
# new agent identity is observed.

\b(?:devin ai|cognition labs)\b
